h1: Frequently bought together for your store
overview: When customers often buy two items together, we make that easy. We review your order history to see which products pair naturally, then set up a frequently bought together block on the product pages where it makes sense. Shoppers can add the pair in one tap with the right variant selected. We write clear labels, check discounts are correct and test the full path from product page to checkout.

faq: Do you use customer data from other stores?
No. Pairs come only from your own order history and the rules you choose. We do not use data from other businesses, and we do not need customer names to find which products sell together.
Can I offer a discount on the pair?
Yes, from Standard. We set it up with your store's own discount tools and check that it applies correctly with taxes and shipping. You choose the amount, and we test it before launch.
What if I have few orders?
Then we start with pairs you choose by hand, such as a camera and a case. As orders grow, the data can replace or add to those pairs. We tell you how many orders give reliable matches.
Does this work with variants like size?
Yes. The shopper picks the size or color for each item before adding the pair. We test common cases, so a missing size or sold out item does not break the block.
